newsitem.title: USA: FSA qualifies nine muni issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: FSA qualifies nine muni issues for insurance.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said Tuesday it qualified for bond insurance the following nine municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
--Laguna Salada Unified School District, Calif., $3.3 million general obligation bonds.
--Frankenmuth, Mich., $2.615 million GOs and $2.6 million downtown development.
--East Aurora, N.Y., $2.79 million various purpose bonds.
--Liverpool Central School District, N.Y., $5.056 million school bonds.
--Phoenix Central School District, N.Y., $2 million school district bonds.
--De Soto Park Development, Texas, $3 million revenue bonds is a direct purchase.
